about: How every time is written, in one table: time_format.py (tests/test_time_format.py) and web/time-format.js (tests/time-format.test.mjs) must both give these answers. clock options: places (0 or 3 digits of milliseconds), nearest (round to the nearest second, halves to even; otherwise the milliseconds are rounded, halves up, and the seconds cut off), hours (false keeps counting minutes past 59), padMinutes (two-digit minutes without hours).
